body:
I was a pothead smoking about three joints a day for almost 10 months, i then was forced to quit by my tyrannical school and submitted to drug tests.  I went clean for the rest of that school year and once summer vacation started again I smoked weed and hashish heavily (8-10joints a day) for about a month.
Then August 2001, I came clean again.  I made it alright, using magic mushrooms about once a week to hold off pot cravings, I used LSA, DMX, codeine, beer, anything to keep my mind off pot.  I read on the web about Catnip which gave light marijuana effects, within two days I ran to a Petstore, bought some catnip, and decided to submit myself to the humiliation of smoking catfood... in a bud form... well it worked fairly well, mostly made me tired and about 1/10th of the feeling of pot.  I decided to keep using it though it was making me think about weed even more.  However the catnip was helping me quit smoking cigarrettes so I figured that this is a balanced system.  After a week of smoking catnip I was intensely craving pot, so... I bummed about a bowl of premium British Columbian Bud off  a friend, mixed it in with a big joint of catnip and blazed.
Maybe it was the pot, maybe it was the fact I hadn't smoked weed for almost 2 months, but wow,.. what a high... I felt very relaxed, I always used to get mild paranoia, and a fast heart beat... not this time, I was euphoric, it brought me back to the days when I was a newbie to smoking pot and got very high, in fact it was one of the best highes I've had in the last year... I was very happy about it..
Also I was higher for longer, with less burning out, more energy, some awareness, and more intense visual pot effects... all in all Catnip and Cannabis are a very good mixture and as soon as a holiday comes up soon I'm sure I'll do some extensive research into this mixture.
